_comment: Curated archetypes offered by the New Maven Project wizard. These are treated as vetted: the wizard
runs them without a consent prompt, whereas a user-typed GAV or an entry pulled from Maven Central's
full catalog is third-party code and must be confirmed first.
Keep this list short and boring — it is a starting point, not a directory. Anything missing is one
Versions are pinned so a generation is reproducible; bump them deliberately.

archetypes.description: A plain Java application with JUnit — the standard starting point
A Java web application packaged as a WAR
A minimal project with no sample sources
A Maven site with example documentation
A JavaFX application with FXML views
An Apache Camel route written in Java
A Scala project built with Maven
